## Skin Stitcher (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 CE Medium aberration  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., skin scent; Perception +11  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)  
 **hp** 45 (7d8+14)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +4, **Will** +6  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** spiked chain +9 (2d4+4/x3) or 2 claws +8 (1d4+3)  
 **Special Attacks** augmented critical, rage  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 14, **Con** 14, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 20  
 **Feats** Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (spiked chain)  
 **Skills** Climb +13, Intimidate +8, Perception +11, Stealth +12  
 **Gear** spiked chain  

**Special Abilities**

 **Augmented Critical (Ex)** If the skin stitcher scores a critical hit with a chain rake, it deals triple normal damage to an opponent.  

 **Rage (Ex)** A skin stitcher that takes damage in combat has a 50% chance of flying into a berserk rage the following round, attacking its foe until either it or its opponent is dead. It gains +4 Strength and -4 AC while raging. The skin stitcher cannot end its rage voluntarily. Note that the skin stitcher does not drop its chains while raging.  

 **Skin Scent (Ex)** The skin stitcher can detect any living creature that possesses natural skin to a distance of one-half mile. This includes all creature types, in most cases, except plants, elementals, oozes, constructs, vermin, and many undead (undead with flesh, such as zombies, can be detected by a skin stitcher, but skeletons cannot).  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any land and underground  
 **Organization** solitary or gang (2-4)  
 **Treasure** standard
